title: npm script name 修复 — ci.yml/dual-engine.yml 引 type-check 但 package.json 是 typecheck
description:
PR #150 canary 抓到 CI `TypeScript Type Check` job 报 `npm error Missing script: type-check`. 根因: workflow 引 `npm run type-check` 但 `node/package.json` scripts 里是 `typecheck` (无横杠).

**核对 2 处不一致**:
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:51` — `run: npm run type-check` (workflow)
- `.github/workflows/dual-engine.yml:19` — `Node typecheck` (workflow 名称含横杠)
- `node/package.json` scripts — `typecheck: tsc --noEmit` (无横杠)

**修法** (choose one, master 拍板):
- Option A: 改 workflow → `npm run typecheck` (2 处 workflow 改动, 保 package.json 原样)
- Option B: 改 package.json → add `type-check` alias (or rename), 保 workflow 原样

**推荐 Option A** — workflow 一致跟 kebab-case Node 生态惯例 (但 script name 已有 typecheck 用户可能记熟了). 主公拍.

**关联**: main 分支 CI 从没跑过所以此 bug 一直隐藏, 直到 4-branch flow 第一次真走到 main.
acceptance: workflow 引用的 npm script name 在 package.json 存在
CI TypeScript Type Check job PASS
本地 `cd node && npm run <script>` 可跑

verification.dual_engine_note: dual-engine.yml line 19 has step NAME 'Node typecheck' but the run: command is 'cd node && npx tsc --noEmit' (direct tsc invocation, does NOT call npm run type-check). No mismatch to fix in dual-engine.yml. Only ci.yml required a change.
